claim.note: XTheFarmerX states x2 at 20% catalyst quality, citing 300-400 attempts by unnamed testers (not his own count on screen, so creator_stated, not measured). The community model (poe2wiki; Craft of Exile per KB §4) says x5. The same creator says 'like 5x odds' with no quality level in another video. Point follows the only quality-specific creator statement; the band spans the community model. Settle with an owner in-game count.

conflicts.topic: Omen of Catalysing Exaltation weight multiplier at 20% catalyst quality

positions.text: at 20% quality it doubles the weighting (testing 'to the tune of 300-400 attempts', by others)
'like 5x odds' on the catalysed mod; quality level not stated, no attempts counted
5x weight at 20% quality (community model; the omen's item text gives no number)

conflicts.resolution: No primary source gives a number (entity catalog 0.5.5b item text has none), and no creator counted attempts on screen, so rule 2/3 (measured beats stated) cannot apply. Point = the quality-specific creator statement (x2), band [2, 5] spans the community model. The planner must show this odds input as [cf], and an owner in-game count (KB §10 T10-style test) replaces it.

claim.note: Keyson: a desecration reveal shows three options. GGG 0.3.0 notes: 'selecting one of three different options' (KB §5, verified-primary). The options can be rerolled once with Omen of Abyssal Echoes (RePoE OmenOnAbyssRerollOptions, KB desecration-abyss). Keyson's caption says 'twice on the omen of light'; Omen of Light removes the desecrated mod, so the reroll is read as Echoes, and the prior is the three options per reveal either way.
